British Airways Flight Declares Emergency Over Ireland

A British Airways flight en route to Chicago declared an emergency over Ireland and descended to 9,000 feet. One report states the plane plunged 28,000 feet, while another indicates a drop of 27,000 feet. The flight turned back and returned to London Heathrow.
